K1.text: No sessions or accounts; single-user local tool with no auth system.

K2.text: No users or privileged roles exist.

K3.text: Swept all 10 routes: none has any auth check, including GET /api/skills/run and /api/agents/run which spawn the claude CLI; SEC-01 (fixed a009fce) narrows exposure to loopback only, so any local process or a cross-site browser GET can still reach them, and the optional token check was deliberately not done.

K4.text: No tenants or owners. Note: projectPath query param on /api/agents/run is not validated against configured paths (swept, SEC-02 covered by loopback bind only).

K5.text: No public unauthenticated write surface; loopback-only after SEC-01.

K7.text: Local loopback tool, no security headers set and none required by its trusted-machine model.

K8.text: Spawned claude process inherits full process.env (every shell secret) with a caller-supplied prompt; no tracked secrets, no VITE/NEXT_PUBLIC vars, config.json is gitignored.

K10.text: Logging is only a startup line, but several catch blocks return raw err.message to the client and it was not deeply reviewed; low risk on loopback.

K11.text: Only env var is PORT with inline default; no .env files.

K12.text: No database and no test suite.

K13.text: No privileged changes to audit; single user.

K14.text: Own fixed port 4173 in config default matching the port table; no Vercel deploy so ignoreCommand and cron routes do not apply.
